reviews.comment: Dr. Gammenthaler is a great guy, and I really enjoyed 125! There is normally one weekly assignment and some essays sprinkled throughout. Our discussions were interesting and made me more curious and self-aware. Dr. G does a great job creating a community, and I made some of my best friends through this class. 125 is a blast!

Use the class time to do Econ, curriculum is simple. Study for midterm and final. Group presentations are easy. If you have bad anxiety about it, go to Beutel and get some meds to take before. They helped me go from having a panic attack in front of the class to getting a 92 on my last presentation! Make friends!

Dr. G is a great professor to have for busn 101. The class is super easy, and that makes it hard to stay engaged, but Dr. G does his best to keep us engaged and thinking. Do not stress at all about this class, just show up, give effort, and it will be the easiest class you've taken. Also, he brings his kids into class and that's super cute!

TAKE HIS CLASS IF YOU CAN. His lectures aren't always extremely interesting, but they are important and you really don't have to do anything besides listen. I never once took notes and as long as you pay attention you should do just fine. I really enjoyed his class and he did try to make it fun and interesting relating to what he's discussing.

Overall good, large group classes are just him lecturing the entire time, and small group classes on Friday were Hullabaloo requirements + group projects. There are a few case studies worth a good amt of your grade but are relatively easy.
Best professor I have taken so far. Would highly recommend.

Not a hard course / prof whatsoever, but feels like not much is actually taught in class, like you'll sit there and realize half an hour has gone by and you have not learned anything. Easy A though, just hug rubric for those case study essays, and do peer reviews! read the syllabus. Three group presentations

He is overall a great professor and very kind-hearted! I would recommend him to any freshman taking BUSN 101 because he tries to make his lectures more fun. The downside is the class is MWF, and Fridays are section group get-togethers, where you do group presentations or someone comes to talk to the class. attendance is mandatory but shouldnt be
Mr. G is amazing! He is deeply intellectual, considerate, and involved. You should absolutely take him!

Mr. G is amazing! He takes the time to talk to every one of his students and knows all of their names. We have a huge semester project that involves a lot of different things but he guides you through everything. Great guy, I recommend taking him for this course.

Dr G was great and made the transition from hs to college easy. 60% of your grade comes from case summary papers, but they really aren't difficult. A significant chunk of your grade comes from peer review, so make sure you get that done. His classes can get boring at times, but the peer leaders take attendance and it counts for grade points.
Super great guy! Take the class with him if you can. Pretty writing heavy course but that goes for all BUSN101 sections, but nothing that you cannot handle.

Dr. G is fantastic! Very caring and genuinely wants you to succeed in life. I would take his class over and over and over again. My favorite professor in my first semester of college! Beware: This course is a writing-heavy class, and you WILL have to put in effort to succeed in those assignments.

Mr. G is a fantastic professor! Super funny and kind, and he is great to talk to. BUSN 101 is an easy class, and there are only two exams. Several critical thinking problems/essays that were not difficult. This class is meant to be an A. His TAs were terrible though and did not provide feedback or explain why they would take off points.
BEST BUSN PROF BY FAR!!! He is SO CARING and just awesome. I loved him so much that I'm a peer mentor for him this year. TAKE HIM HE IS AMAZING
Super sweet guy. I am trying to take another class with him if possible. Just study textbook and class is an easy A. Very caring and will listen to any concerns / questions you have

Awesome professor, and makes it fun to come to lecture every class. Had a very welcoming presence, and was always nice and understanding when talking to him. Quizzes were easy, make sure to look over the vocab/key terms. Friday classes are with small groups where you have a couple group projects and assignments, serving as a FYEX, but they are easy

I love Mr. G!! He's great the class is so fun and he really cares about hearing student perspectives.  Make sure you go to class and participate in all the assignments and you'll do fine.  I made so many friends from the group projects and class discussion activities we did, would take this class again in a heartbeat.

If you put in effort for this class you will get an A. Mr. G wants his students to do well and is very transparent about exam content and grades. The small groups are very helpful and the peep leaders want to help you. Take his class!
Awesome prof. Easy class.

Mr. G was a fun and easy prof! The class itself is easy and not super complicated, and he was helpful in giving some advice and overall direction about college and picking a major. 
Group lecture by him 2x/week, and peer leader mtg in small group section (~20kids) every Friday. 2 exams, team presentations and critical thinking papers. Easy A

Mr. G is a super caring guy who really wants to help you learn about business! He does grade attendance, but it's worth very little. The graders for this class are super nit picky, but you can still get good grades if you try. It's an easy A if you show up, study a little for the exams, and write a good paper. I would take him again if I could!

Super awesome class. Professor keeps you engaged. We have small group on Fridays and we got tips on resumes, interviews, as well as just being able to get to know some people in a closer space. Great class, great professor!

Great prof! Easy class if you go to class and study. Homework seems like a lot but is simple. Study the slides and the key terms for exams. Reading the text book is optional IMO. Friday discussions are fun if you have good peer leaders. Presentations seem scary but are not hard if you prepare. Advice: put bullet points (talking points) on slides.

Mandatory class. I'm so thankful I took it with Mr. G! The graders graded the writing assignments tough. Mr. G keeps class interesting and really cares about his students and his job. The peer leaders also play a large role in enjoyment of the class, and I had amazing ones. There are group projects and the expectations are clear. It was a fun time!

Nice guy! Business 101 is supposed to be a super easy blow-off class. However, this wasn't the case for me. I don't think the professor is the one grading the writing assignments, but whoever is grading is SO harsh. You'll submit an assignment following the rubric and instructions to a T, and somehow, you'll get 20 points off!! Its ridiculous.
Fantastic professor who cares a lot about his class.

Mr. G is an amazing professor. I took him for BUSN 101, which is an easy class if you simply do the work expected of you. Mr. G delivers great lectures and is always willing to talk to you. Take him for BUSN 101!

Mr. G is a wonderful human being. Most of the grading comes from the TAs/Peer Leaders, and I've noticed that's VERY luck of the draw, with the grade distributions varying a lot. This is a required business course and I would recommend Mr. G above the other professors.

I loved Prof Gammenthaler. He made lectures interesting and engaged with the class. The exams weren't awful if you studied for them and the group presentations weren't stressful because it was in your small group. There is a weekly quiz but it's very easy. Take him if you can, he's amazing and accommodating and knows that we are human.
He is super sweet and understanding! His lectures and guest speakers are very interesting to listen to. Small group presentations are super important!!

Prof Gammenthaler is amazing! Classwork was easy and the PowerPoints contained all the information needed for exams. Easy class and a great introduction to college coursework. The only issue is TA's grading and being nit-picky over papers but never received a B.

Gammenthaler is BY FAR the best professor I had this semester. The assignments we did for the class wasn't just the ordinary "busy work," it was stuff that actually had me look at business in a different perspective. Gammenthaler was the best and cared so much about everyone in class. If I could take him again I would in a heartbeat.

this class is lecture heavy since that's what's on the exams however not much was taught during lectures so exams were kind of hard. honestly the most boring class i've ever taken. your peer leader makes or breaks this class as well. i hated this class so much. weds classes are literally learning how to critically think.
Mr. G is extremely kind and caring, as well as very engaging in the classroom. I loved class with him this semester and would recommend a class with him to anybody!
Proffesor Gammenthaler is amazing, one of the best professors in A&M. As long as you go to class and participate, and do what is needed, his class is not that hard. He really cares about his students

I honestly do not want this class to end. Professor G is amazing and he made me WANT to go to class. I enjoyed his lectures and this is coming from someone who doesn't love school. He truly is an amazing professor and I would recommend him to everyone!

Professor Gammenthaler is a professor you want to take. He's a super nice guy, really easy to talk to, and cares about his students a lot. His lectures can sometimes be boring but it's not his fault, he teaches very well. If you can take him, do so.

Professor G is one of the most caring teachers I have had. He is very engaging and really cares about all his students. The group objects, which are presentations, are the most difficult part, but not too hard. My peer mentors were also great for small group on Friday. Expect weekly quizzes and reading, along with some papers.

Prof G is by far my favorite professor that I have had so far at TAMU! His lectures are interesting and he gives a lot of useful insight into each major within Mays. Not a lot of studying is required, and the presentations are with a group and are actually kind of fun. I definitely recommend Prof G, he is one of the best!

Prof G is a really nice professor, he's really funny and caring as well and gives good lectures. Attendance does matter and is an easy grade for the class, but the weekly quizzes are easy and make sure you know the content for the papers in class (there are only three papers for the whole semester). But overall, he is a really great professor.

Gammenthaler is a great professor! He truly does care for his students and his classes are basically just lectures and quizzes every week. Make sure to study for the midterm and final though! Other than that he is great!

Professor Gammenthaler was a great professor to have as one of my first in college. I love showing up to his classes and his lectures were very easy to pay attention too. Attendance wasn't mandatory but I recommend to do well on mid term and on the final.

Prof G has to be my favorite professor last semester. He understood that he was teaching a freshman level class and designed his class so. He did a really good job explaining business and is very well-educated. He wants his students to succeed and doesn't view the class as a class you shouldn't have to work hard in.

I LOVED BUSN125 and I felt like the information really set me up for success at A&M! This class is easy as long as you show up and take the reading quizzes which are easy! The presentation is fine if you are prepared and I made great friends in the class! He is an awesome person and wants to get to know his students! I love his teaching style!

Super cool professor. His lectures are not boring at all. You do get into groups to discuss for some of the lectures. Take notes during lectures and read the textbook! Making quizlet's for the key terms helped me a lot. Test are fairly easy but if you study and know your stuff you will be fine. There are weekly quizzes but they super easy. 10/10

Professor Gammenthaler is the best FBI teacher you can have! He really cares about his students! Do the textbook readings as you are tested on it as well as pay somewhat of your attention to him during class. You don't have much out-of-class work except towards the end of the semester with your group project. You are graded on few things so beware!

Mr. Gammenthaler has been one of my favorite professors so far. He really cares about his students and also encourages us to do good in todays world. This class is very maintainable if you take the time to do the assignments

Prof G is such a nice person! He genuinely cares about the students and wants us to learn the material. Though he had a lot going on this semester, he made time for the students and ensured a quality freshman class experience. I'd say Prof G is the best FBI prof you could take. 100% Recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Gammenthaler is awesome, he was so understanding when it came to grading. He cared about our growth as individuals, not just wanting us to learn about Mays. His classes were entertaining and helpful. Assignments were not hard.
Great professor! Would definitely recommend.

Text book is free. He was a very nice guy and does care about his students. Hes great at communication too. He give out his slides before the mid term and final exam(only 2 tests). But if you take this class you NEED to read the textbook or you wont do well. I made that mistake before the midterm.
He was so funny and relatable

He is such a great prof! He really cares about his students and tries to make everything run smoothly and easily. The midterm was a bit challenging but I heard that the format of this course changes every semester. We had group projects which were easy as well. Take him for BUSN 101!!
Professor Gammanthaler is super down to earth, caring, and gives great lectures. Highly recommend him for a low stress professor!

Prof G is so amazing. He truly cares about your success as an individual not just a student. His lectures are clear and easy to understand. Most of your grades come from your small group assignments (super easy) and a weekly async quiz. You can tell he loves his job and is super approachable. Talks ab philanthropies and invites you to volunteer
He was so engaging and fun to be in class with. He felt more like a friend than a professor. Highly recommend taking any class by him!

Amazing prof!!! Really cares about students. Teaches interesting lessons on the nonprofit sector and how to give money strategically. I really enjoyed this course! A good amount of reading is required, but it is interesting and worth it. Discussion based course with reflective writing.

Kyle is an amazing professor who really cares about his students, which is evident every day he lectures. He does not push an agenda and truly wants each student to succeed. I would absolutely take him!

Professor Gammenthaler truly cares for his students and the classes he teaches. Through his Resource Development class, I had the opportunity to have true hands-on experience in the nonprofit sector, which is something I haven't experienced yet. He gives great feedback on EVERY assignment and really cares about his students. Cancels class sometimes
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Kyle is a wonderful individual! He's very thoughtful, and really provokes all of his students to reflect upon experiences and beliefs. The class (strategic philanthropy) allowed me to gain real experience interacting with nonprofits, gave me the opportunity to meet some influential individuals, and truly engage. 10/10 would recommend!
